description: Returns a 1-hour link where the user uploads their own photos and files into a folder of a site; get_site lists them afterwards. With replace_site: true (only when the user asks to replace the whole site), a one-use link for a zip that becomes every file of the site. Publishes nothing until the user uploads.

folder.description: Target folder (default images); not with replace_site

replace_site.description: true: a one-use link for a zip that replaces the whole site

site_token.description: site_token from the first deploy (anonymous sites only)

name: create_upload_link
title: Get an upload link
